about_the_game:
Non-violent hero is a pixel RPG where you can interact with a cast of cute and memorable characters!

You play as a charming hero who refuses to use violence to solve problems. When the king’s daughter is kidnapped by the Demon King, he turns to you for help. It's the perfect chance to join a unique adventure!

With just your wits and choices, you can reach different endings and shape the story in unexpected ways.

If you can answer questions, you can easily explore this world, way easier than taking an exam!

Features:

  • No violence include! Solve problems with wisdom, not weapons!

  • A small town, with a few villagers living in it.

  • Rescue the princess...or not! It’s all up to you.

  • Have eleven endings.
